description.value:
Long before the Academy, you wrestled siblings and ninken in the dirt. You become trained in Survival, and your unarmed Strikes deal 1d6 piercing damage (instead of 1d4 bludgeoning) and gain the finesse and agile traits, representing your clan's claw-and-fang fighting style.
